purpose: Authoritative catalogue of every DeepSeek Harness desktop distribution found on this machine, with an explicit verdict on whether it can be run as an isolated Hub-managed instance.
scanScope: D:\ recursive to depth 5 for 'DeepSeek Harness.exe' and 'app.asar'; C:\ LocalAppData\Programs, Program Files, Program Files (x86), LocalAppData for DeepSeek/DSH directories
isolationRule: A distribution may be registered as a launchable Hub instance ONLY if it honours DSH_DESKTOP_USER_DATA and DSH_DESKTOP_PORT. Without them an instance falls back to the shared %APPDATA% Electron userData, the shared <user-profile>\.dsh home and the default port, which is exactly the cross-instance interference this Hub exists to prevent. Such distributions are catalogued and archived, never launched.

archiveRelocation.note: On 2026-09-23 the scattered D-drive assets were MOVED (not copied) into the Hub archive. Every 'path', 'executable', 'bundledArchive' and nonDesktopDshAssets path elsewhere in this file is the PRE-ARCHIVE original and must be resolved through this map. Historical manifests (asset-inventory.json, migration.json, source-lock.json) are deliberately left frozen as evidence of the state at the time they were written.
archiveRelocation.verified: every move was verified by file count, total bytes and executable SHA-256 before/after
